messages:
maria: Heads-up: were launching A800 Edge Dedicated pools (preview) in Singapore and Manila on Mon 08:00 SGT / Mon 09:00 PHT. These are purpose-built for low-latency edge inference with fast cold-starts. Capacity will be limited and gated to pilot customers only.

oliver: Nice — whats the availability model? preemptible, reserved, or mixed? :eyes: 

maria: Mixed. Primary mode is reserved for pilot tenants during their reservation windows. Outside reservation windows the hardware enters a preemptible rotation to allow bursty non-critical jobs. Were calling it "rotation_mode" with two knobs: reservation_window and preempt_cycle (default 6h).

tasha: Ops note: rotation means workloads can be evicted if not pinned. We added a "pin=true" label customers can set on workloads to avoid rotation, but pinning consumes reservation quota. Use pin sparingly.

oliver: CLI examples in case teams want to opt-in: 
```
redwood pools reserve --pool a800-sg --start 2026-04-06T08:00Z --duration 4h --reservation-window 240
redwood workload update --workload-id w-123 --pin true
```

maria: Billing: preview rates are 60% of GA list. Preemptible usage billed at a lower per-minute rate; pinned/reserved usage billed at preview reserved rate. Billing-team will add a usage label "rotation_state" to invoices so customers can see preemptible vs reserved charge breakdowns.

billing-team: Confirmed. Well emit billing tags next invoice cycle and show a breakdown in the Console Cost panel.

tasha: Runtime/drivers: A800 needs driver stack 7.0.x+ and runtime v3.0.0. Private deployments must upgrade before we enable routing to A800. We pushed a compatibility checklist to the infra-runbook.

infra-bot: Runbook published: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/a800-edge-rotation-preview (internal) :link: 

oliver: Migration guidance: enable lightweight checkpointing, keep KV cache warm between reservation windows using keepalive pings, and mark long-running training jobs as not-eligible for rotation. Well auto-fallback to A600 pools when rotation eviction occurs.

maria: Pilot selection: PMs will nominate accounts. If youre running customer pilots, DM me account ids. Ops will schedule reserved slots (weekday daytime + one overnight slot) and a nightly 00:00-01:00 maintenance blackout.

tasha: Metrics to watch: rotation_evictions, avg_cold_start_ms, pinned_quota_utilization. We added dashboards under Dedicated > Pools > A800 (preview).

maria: TL;DR: A800 Edge preview in SG & MNL, mixed reserved+preemptible rotation model, pinning available but uses quota, preview billing/tags, runbook + dashboards live. Ping me or ops for pilot access. :sparkles:
